title: Maintenance Therapy Days on a Vacation Release
content:
A Pharmacy Benefit vacation release of a drug the member refills regularly carries maintenance days.

**Clause.** The maintenance days are seven (7) where the same drug has two or more paid refills in the last three months, three (3) where it has exactly one, and nothing otherwise.

The drug is the one named on the latest vacation override granted on the coverage; its paid refills are the fills of that drug on the member's pharmacy claims that are refills, with a fill date in the last three months. The maintenance days are added to the vacation release days once the days on hand have been taken off the plan's most extra days supply; the release that results is never fewer than one day and never more than the plan's most extra days supply one vacation override releases.

### Table

| Paid refills of the same drug, last three months | Maintenance days |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 7 |
| Exactly one | 3 |
| None | Nothing |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Three paid refills of the drug in the last three months: 7 days.
- One paid refill of the drug and four of other drugs: 3 days — only refills of the same drug count.
